closes.text: FIXED. The copy was `assume()`'s lend refreshing its B526 fallback on every read (`last = Some(*payload)`), plus one more copy at `assume()` itself. The fallback is now taken by a KEEPER: a store feed `assume()` stands on the variant's flag node (`self.gate`), whose `before` copies the payload once, in the write that ends the variant, before it lands; `store_switch` now tells the two flags' feeds when a variant comes or goes (no inner write's spine passes a flag, so an edit in a live body never fires it; an outer variant's end reaches it through `store_wake_all`). The handle reads in place and falls back to the keeper's copy only once the variant is dead; the keeper goes with the ambient owner (`defer_to_owner`: the body's under `when_live`/`when_remote_live`), and outside any owner stands for the store's life (`register_with_owner`'s rule). Semantics restated as 'the payload as it stood when the variant ended' (never older than the old 'last read' rule; the two B526/A142 pins unchanged and green). The item's repro, 2,000 title reads at 10 / 1,000 / 10,000 records: node 15.0 / 280 / 4,148 ms -> 10.4 / 4.3 / 4.5 ms; native release 2 / 68 / 646 -> 1 / 1 / 1 ms (debug 10 / 316 / 3,102 -> 6 / 6 / 7). `__clone` calls per 100 reads at 1,000 records 807,800 -> 7,400 (the remainder is path-list copies, M186). Pins: 11 `inference::store::b693_*` (one per way a variant ends - the enum's handle, Option -> None, a key set to None / removed under `at(id).some()`, a whole-state write, an outer variant; the copy count per phase at 10 vs 1,000 records; the codegen shape - one `__clone(payload)` in the keeper, none in the lend; the keeper's life on `store_feed_census`; a dead `assume()` refused; live-again reads the new payload), the native differential `store_assume_keeper.vl`. No golden moved. One `[[bump]]` row (fullstack, reference, x1.0005 of next's std where next already stood at x1.0099). Kolt needs nothing: its 28 `when_live`/`when_remote_live` sites get it.
